scope: Actual compareImages pipeline; in-memory instrumentation of built classifier. No images copied or uploaded. Stage counts describe rejection, not whether a difference is harmless.
groundTruth: Existing PR #375 declarations, not newly independently certified here. No real Figma API/host or AI source edits.
limitations: Fixture verdict labels are preserved historical declarations; stage rejection does not establish a false failure.
Topology is evaluated before halo attempts. Counts cover the actual pipeline's selected regions and its region caps.
At most three examples per stage are retained here; full per-call details stay in the local temporary directory.
